args.description: A SINGLE EMPTY horizontal fantasy game action button, native pixel art for Dungeon Matcher mobile settings. Front view, 248 pixels wide by 48 pixels tall. Fill nearly the entire canvas, leaving 1 pixel of transparent breathing room. Crisp thick PALE SILVER STONE/METAL rim, simple square bracket side mounts with one restrained dark rivet on each side, softly clipped square corners. Broad flat quiet muted charcoal-violet interior face, enough free space for a long label and a 24px icon later. Top-left light, broad planar bevels, no shiny mirror/chrome, no random cracks or speckles. Match clean dark outlines, pale silver material planes, and readable chunky fantasy menu parts. The button is RECTANGULAR and horizontal, not a scroll. NO text, NO letters, NO icons, NO skulls, NO gemstones, NO decoration in the interior. Individual transparent UI sprite. Clear connected rim, consistent rail thickness, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradient, no drop shadow outside canvas.
